what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Migrated-scripts update is inverted: it adds new active Step 18 files and excludes the deleted legacy wrappers
scenario_or_breakage: python/migrated-scripts.tsv is the retired-path manifest. Adding active step-18.sh or step-18.md can make make lint-retired-scripts flag the new SKILL/docs references, while omitting the deleted wrappers removes the required stale-reference guard.
suggested_fix: Keep the new active step-18.* files out of python/migrated-scripts.tsv. Append only the six deleted legacy Step 18 .sh/.md paths, then update or reword remaining exact retired-path references before make lint.

what: Step 18a.5 escalation-success gate has no concrete execution point after the wrapper absorbs Step 18b and teardown
scenario_or_breakage: Current Step 18 runs the escalation-success report gate after the active stall gate and before Step 18b. The proposed wrapper goes from no-stall gate to final-report and finalize, so a recovered run with escalation evidence can tear down without the required success report.
suggested_fix: Add the existing Step 18a.5 normalize-outcome and escalation-success procedure inside step-18.sh after the stall gate clears and before final-report step18b. Keep the SKILL.md flow aligned with that placement.
